rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese name for the breed, especially when introducing or describing the dog.

example.english: The beagle at my home is very well-behaved.
example.traditional: 我屋企隻比格犬好乖㗎。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 zek3 bei2 gaak3 hyun2 hou2 gwaai1 gaa3

rows.note: Use this alternative established breed name when referring to a beagle by its conventional translated name.

example.traditional: 呢隻狗嘅品種係米格魯。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gau2 ge3 ban2 zung2 hai6 mai5 gaak3 lou5
